items.title: В Азербайджане автоматизируют передачу обращений из службы "102" в банки
items.summary: Azerbaijan is automating the transfer of requests from the "102" service to banks. The headline gives no detail on the channel or banks involved.
items.idea: We could build an in-app flow that receives official 102 service requests and lets customers respond or pay directly, starting with a pilot for one request type.

dependencies: CBA and government agency agreement on data exchange with banks
Consent and personal data handling rules
risks: Scope of the 102 channel is unclear from the headline, so the pilot could be built on the wrong flow
Government data exchange may take longer than planned
Low volume if few request types are routed to banks
sim.pilot: Confirm with the agency which single request type would be sent to banks and map its data fields for a one-type pilot.
sim.mechanism: Birbank would receive official requests from the 102 service inside the app as a notification with a respond or pay action, letting customers answer or settle directly without visiting a branch.
sim.segment: Retail customers who receive official service requests and pay fees or respond to government notices through banks.

items.title: Azerbaijan to expand open banking to legal entities and cross-bank transfers
items.summary: Azerbaijan plans to extend open banking to legal entities and to cross-bank transfers. Only the headline is available, and no launch date is given.
items.idea: We could prepare SME account-linking and cross-bank transfer flows so Birbank is ready once the CBA rules take effect.

dependencies: CBA rules for open banking extended to legal entities
Agreements or API standards with other banks
risks: No launch date, so the timing of the regulatory change is unknown
Other banks may not be ready for shared APIs
Business onboarding requires extra KYC and authority checks
sim.pilot: Draft the SME account-linking consent flow and check it against current CBA open banking rules.
sim.mechanism: Birbank would let business customers link accounts from other banks and send cross-bank transfers from the app, using consented open banking access once the CBA rules allow it.
sim.segment: Small and medium businesses that hold accounts in several Azerbaijani banks and pay suppliers or staff.

items.title: В Азербайджане планируется расширить открытый банкинг на юридических лиц
items.publisher: Trend - Новости Азербайджана. Турция, Иран, Центральна Азия
items.summary: Azerbaijan is planning to extend open banking to legal entities. Only the headline is available.
items.idea: We could scope a business-account open banking connector for SMEs to be ready when the CBA extends the rules.

dependencies: CBA extension of open banking to legal entities
Role-based access rules for company users
risks: Only the headline is confirmed, so the rule scope is uncertain
Read-only connector may give limited engagement without payments
Overlaps with the cross-bank SME flow if both are built
sim.pilot: Scope a read-only business-account connector for one partner bank and review the CBA draft rules for legal entities.
sim.mechanism: Birbank would offer a business-account connector in the app that reads balances and transactions from linked accounts at other banks, once CBA rules cover legal entities.
sim.segment: SME owners and finance staff who manage accounts across several banks.
